readings.primaryObject: Hard session-budget governance with pause-and-resume semantics for managed Digital Employees
readings.keyBoundary: The hard budget is enforced between model requests and can overshoot by already-admitted in-flight work; budget exhaustion pauses the durable session rather than terminating it.

readings.primaryObject: Centrally managed model policy that forces automatic review and permission downgrades
readings.keyBoundary: Protected model slugs are unioned across managed layers and enforced through exact matching, startup permission shaping, runtime validation and model-aware MCP reviewer routing; the evidence does not establish production review accuracy.

readings.primaryObject: Versioned gRPC host protocol for agent code-mode sessions and executions
readings.keyBoundary: The v1 protobuf makes session, execution, wait, callback, notification and content-result boundaries explicit, but the selected change does not establish authentication, version negotiation, retry/idempotency or end-to-end concurrency guarantees.
